 Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Applications stand disposed of.

3. This is a petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking quashing of the FIR No.
0087/2015 dated 04.02.2015 P.S. Zafrabad under Sections 120B, 34,420,448,468,471 and 506 IPC.
4. Learned Senior Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the nature of the dispute is essentially of civil nature and the cross suits are pending between the parties.
Further, the parties are related to each other.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:17:36 5.

He submits that the dispute pertains to the management of a School run by Seth Bhagwan Dass Education Society, Maujpur and the complainant at whose instance the FIR was registered and who happened to be the brother of petitioner no. 1's father has expired in the meantime on 22.10.2020.
